rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: JACgate
Exhibition name: Brandenburg Gate ™
rows.Origin:
Bred by William A. Warriner (United States, before 1990).
Introduced in United States by Bear Creek Gardens, Inc. in 1990 as 'Brandenburg Gate'.
rows.Bloom: Red. Flowers red with light reverse. Mild fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Berlin's Brandenburg Gate is the last of its original fourteen gates. It is the site of the biggest New Year's party in Europe.

colour: Red. Flowers red with light reverse.
